title: The nth Term of an AP — Arithmetic Progressions
hook: Let's explore The nth Term of an AP from the chapter on Arithmetic Progressions. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
The nth Term of an AP The general (nth) term of an AP is aₙ = a + (n−1)d. This formula lets you find any term directly without listing all previous terms. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 General term: aₙ = a + (n−1)d
💡 To find which term has a given value: solve a + (n−1)d = value for n
💡 If aₙ is negative, the AP has started decreasing past zero
💡 Last term often denoted by 'l': l = a + (n−1)d
